title: Types of Attributes
key_points: Data preprocessing is crucial and time-consuming, often requiring hands-on experience.
Data is the most important part of the whole process in data mining.
Most data comes from databases, specifically relational databases which use tables.
Attributes are columns in a table, and rows represent transactions or records.
There are four main types of attributes: Nominal, Ordinal, Interval, and Ratio.
Nominal attributes are categorical and only allow equality comparisons.
Ordinal attributes allow for order comparisons (e.g., rank order).
Interval attributes allow for addition and subtraction, but not multiplication/division.
Ratio attributes allow for all arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division).
